examples: See the red menu bar icon, click it, click the update row, and watch the window go from downloading to restarting.
Turn on update automatically and never see the icon, the row, the notice or the window: the app updates itself when no session is working.
Update studio from this computer without touching it, then switch its auto update on.
how_to: Open settings, general, updates. The block shows the running version and what the updater says.

When the menu bar icon turns red with an up arrow, click it and click the first row, 'update to X: download, install and restart'. A small window shows the download, the check, the install and the restart. Nothing else to confirm.
The notice in Notification Center carries an update button; clicking the notice itself does the same.
Press check now to look for a new version, and update now when one is waiting. The app downloads it, stops the server and restarts; your sessions keep running.
Turn on update automatically to download new versions in the background and restart into them when no session is working. It is off by default.
To update a paired computer, open the Pack page, Computers, and use update now or the update automatically switch on its row. A computer on an older version shows 'update it by hand once'.
media_exempt: the Electron tray icon, menu, Notification Center notice and native update window cannot be captured by the browser capture rig; the real proof is the next release installed on a Tart guest
name: App updates
summary: the desktop app updates itself from the public releases: a red menu bar icon and a one-click row when you update by hand, or fully automatically if you turn it on.
where: The menu bar icon turns red with a white up arrow while an update waits (auto update off), and the first row of its menu is the one-click update.
A Notification Center notice with an update button, once per version.
Pack page, Computers: each computer's row.
